proposal.name: merged plan decision follow-up

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The workflow starts in Init and advances only through Next steps.

statements.name: MergeRequiresCurrentCI
statements.says: The factory merges a follow-up only with passing CI for its current contents.

statements.name: OneFollowup
statements.says: A plan's decision obligation produces at most one follow-up pull request.

statements.name: RepairAllowance
statements.says: The factory uses at most two automatic repairs in each allowance.

statements.name: HumanHoldRespected
statements.says: Closure, exhausted repairs and definitive merge refusal hold the same follow-up for a person, and observations and in-flight outcomes preserve that hold until an authorized retry or resume is applied or the PR is confirmed merged.

statements.name: CurrentCIResults
statements.says: A completed CI result always describes the follow-up's current contents.

statements.name: AllowanceAccounting
statements.says: Only a repair consumes the repair allowance, and only an explicit retry or resume resets it.

statements.name: DeferredResumeSafety
statements.says: Resumption requested during an unresolved effect is remembered without releasing closure or renewing repairs and is applied only after that effect is reconciled as unmerged.

statements.name: OutcomeGuards
statements.says: Only an unresolved executed operation with the matching identity, kind, authorized revision and actual result can accept a completion, and an overtaken publication cannot overwrite the observed head.

statements.name: RepairFailureIsSeparate
statements.says: A failed or unchanged repair settles its attempt, records its execution outcome and cause separately, and preserves the observed head, CI and conflict instead of inventing a CI result or run.

statements.name: EffectRunsOnce
statements.says: An authorized effect executes at most once, and a lost reply retains the same operation and outcome for reconciliation.

statements.name: MergeAuthorizationIsPending
statements.says: Merge authorization requires current passing CI and no conflict or hold and remains nonterminal until the remote outcome is confirmed.

statements.name: MergeRefusalIsTruthful
statements.says: A definitive merge refusal preserves observed facts and closure, and an otherwise ready unchanged PR waits in a merge-refused hold for an explicit retry.

statements.name: ExternalSettlementHonest
statements.says: An externally merged PR is settled as external without inventing CI, changing repair usage or applying a deferred resumption.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every workflow value stays within its declared type.

statements.name: OnlyOwedMergedPlans
statements.says: Decision work starts only after the plan's pull request merges and only if the plan owes a decision.

statements.name: StableFollowupIdentity
statements.says: Creation, repairs, retries and resumption all refer to the same follow-up pull request.

statements.name: DraftUsesEvidence
statements.says: The drafting agent uses the plan, merged change and review as the decision's sources.

statements.name: DecisionClassification
statements.says: The decision is decided by agent exactly when the agent infers that an executed two-way door needs no owner input, and is proposed otherwise.

statements.name: FollowupHasDecision
statements.says: Every created follow-up contains a drafted decision classified as decided or proposed.

statements.name: DecisionCommandUsed
statements.says: The follow-up records its decision by running invariant decisions decide.

statements.name: JournalAndLogAgree
statements.says: The follow-up contains both a journal entry and its log row for the same new decision.

statements.name: CitationsCoverChangedText
statements.says: Every SPEC line and README passage written by the merged change cites the new decision in the follow-up.

statements.name: SpecIsRolledUp
statements.says: The follow-up includes the SPEC roll-up.

statements.name: FollowupScope
statements.says: The follow-up and all its repairs change only decisions/, SPEC.md and the README.

statements.name: MergeWithoutConflict
statements.says: The factory merges a follow-up only when it has no merge conflict.

statements.name: EachRepairStartsFreshCI
statements.says: A published repair invalidates prior CI and requires fresh CI for its new revision without charging the attempt again.

statements.name: RequestsRenewAllowance
statements.says: An applied explicit authorized retry or resume renews the allowance to two repairs, with resumption deferred while an earlier effect is unresolved.

statements.name: ExhaustionIsBlocked
statements.says: An exhausted follow-up has used both repairs and remains blocked even if later observations invalidate its earlier CI failure.

statements.name: DecidedDecisionMerged
statements.says: An executed two-way door inferred to need no owner input can be recorded as decided by agent and merged.

statements.name: OneWayProposedMerged
statements.says: A one-way door can be recorded as proposed and merged.

statements.name: OwnerInputProposedMerged
statements.says: An executed two-way door needing owner input can be recorded as proposed and merged.

statements.name: UnexecutedProposedMerged
statements.says: A two-way door that was not executed can be recorded as proposed and merged.

statements.name: NoDecisionWork
statements.says: A plan can merge without creating a follow-up when it owes no decision.

statements.name: DraftRetried
statements.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed drafting attempt.

statements.name: CreationRetried
statements.says: The factory can automatically retry a failed follow-up creation attempt.

statements.name: RepairCanMerge
statements.says: A repaired follow-up can pass fresh CI and merge.

statements.name: RepairsExhausted
statements.says: A follow-up can exhaust both repairs and block for a person.

statements.name: PersonRenewsExhaustedWork
statements.says: A person can retry an exhausted follow-up with two fresh repairs available.

statements.name: ClosedFollowupWaits
statements.says: A person can close the follow-up and leave its decision obligation waiting for explicit resumption.

statements.name: ResumeRenewsUnusedRepairs
statements.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after one repair can restore two available repairs.

statements.name: ResumeRenewsExhaustedRepairs
statements.says: Resuming a follow-up closed after both repairs can restore two available repairs.

statements.name: DraftProgress
statements.says: An eligible merged plan or a failed drafting attempt eventually starts a drafting attempt.

statements.name: CreationProgress
statements.says: A completed draft or a failed creation attempt eventually starts a follow-up creation attempt.

statements.name: RepairProgress
statements.says: A follow-up needing repair with allowance available eventually authorizes an attempt unless a hold, external settlement or changed observations remove the need.

statements.name: BlockingProgress
statements.says: A follow-up needing repair with no allowance eventually blocks unless it is closed, externally settled or no longer needs repair.

statements.name: MergeProgress
statements.says: A follow-up that remains ready to merge eventually authorizes a merge attempt without promising a remote success.

statements.name: DraftFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually starts a drafting attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: CreationFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually starts a creation attempt whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: RepairFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually authorizes an available repair whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: BlockingFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually blocks exhausted work whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: MergeFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually authorizes a ready merge whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: MergeBeforeCI
statements.says: The factory incorrectly merges while the current CI run is still pending.

statements.name: CreateDuplicate
statements.says: The factory incorrectly creates a second follow-up for the same plan.

statements.name: RepairPastAllowance
statements.says: The factory incorrectly makes a third repair without an explicit request.

statements.name: ResumeWithoutPerson
statements.says: The factory incorrectly resumes a closed follow-up without an explicit request.

statements.name: DecideOneWay
statements.says: The drafting agent incorrectly records a one-way door as decided by agent.

statements.name: RepairAuthorizationCharged
statements.says: Each newly authorized repair consumes exactly one repair before execution, including an attempt that later fails or produces no publishable change.

statements.name: RepairFailureRemainsActionable
statements.says: An unresolved repair execution failure remains eligible for repair or exhaustion rather than waiting for CI that was never requested.

statements.name: RevisionInvalidatesCI
statements.says: Observing a new revision invalidates prior CI without consuming or renewing repairs or lifting a hold.

statements.name: TruthfulFollowupState
statements.says: An unmerged follow-up reports its current hold, unresolved effect or observed repair need truthfully.

statements.name: StableOperationIdentity
statements.says: Every repair or merge authorization gets a new stable operation identity tied to its revision, and execution, reconciliation and rejection preserve that identity.

statements.name: RejectedOutcomesPreserveState
statements.says: Rejecting a stale CI or effect outcome preserves the observed head, CI, conflict, allowance, hold and current operation.

statements.name: FactoryMergeConfirmed
statements.says: A factory-merged follow-up has a confirmed successful remote outcome for its authorized operation and revision.

statements.name: CIPendingWasRequested
statements.says: Pending CI names the current revision and never counts as a completed fresh result.

statements.name: FailedRepairRetainsConflict
statements.says: An agent failure can consume a repair while preserving passing CI and the real merge conflict.

statements.name: NoChangeRetainsCIFailure
statements.says: A repair with no publishable change can consume a repair and retain the real failing CI result.

statements.name: FailedRepairsExhaust
statements.says: Failed repair execution can exhaust both repairs and wait for a person.

statements.name: NoChangeRepairsExhaust
statements.says: Repairs with no publishable change can exhaust both repairs and wait for a person.

statements.name: FailureAllowanceRenewed
statements.says: A person can explicitly renew the allowance after unsuccessful repair execution exhausts it.

statements.name: PublishedRepairInvalidatesCI
statements.says: A published repair can leave its new revision awaiting a fresh CI request with its prior CI invalidated.

statements.name: HeadMovesAfterPassingCI
statements.says: A head change after passing CI can invalidate that result before merging.

statements.name: RevisionKeepsExhaustionHold
statements.says: A head change can invalidate CI while preserving the exhausted allowance and human hold.

statements.name: MergeAuthorizationPending
statements.says: An accepted merge authorization can remain pending before any remote merge has completed.

statements.name: ClosedMergeRefused
statements.says: Closure during an authorized merge can survive a definitive refusal.

statements.name: ConflictedMergeRefused
statements.says: A merge refused after a conflict appears can return to needing repair without fabricating failed CI.

statements.name: MovedHeadMergeRefused
statements.says: A merge refused after head movement can return to the observed new head with invalidated CI.

statements.name: CleanMergeRefused
statements.says: A same-head merge refusal with passing CI and no conflict can wait for an explicit human retry.

statements.name: PersonRetriesRefusedMerge
statements.says: A person can release a merge-refused hold with an explicit retry and a fresh repair allowance.

statements.name: LostRepairReconciled
statements.says: A lost repair reply can be reconciled without executing or charging the attempt twice.

statements.name: LostMergeReconciled
statements.says: A successful remote merge with a lost reply can be reconciled as factory-merged.

statements.name: DeferredResumeWaits
statements.says: An explicit resume can wait behind an unresolved effect while retaining the closure hold and spent allowance.

statements.name: DeferredResumeApplied
statements.says: A remembered resume can automatically apply once reconciliation confirms the PR is still unmerged.

statements.name: DeferredResumeSettledExternally
statements.says: External settlement can cancel a remembered resume without renewing the allowance or reopening the PR.

statements.name: ExternalMergeWithoutPassingCI
statements.says: An external merge can settle a follow-up without supplying an invented passing CI result.

statements.name: OldOperationOutcomeRejected
statements.says: A completion for an older operation can be rejected while a newer operation remains active.

statements.name: OldCIOutcomeRejected
statements.says: A CI result for an older revision can be rejected after head movement.

statements.name: SupersededRepairReconciled
statements.says: A repair publication overtaken by head movement can be reconciled without overwriting the observed head.

statements.name: DeferredResumeProgress
statements.says: Once reconciliation leaves a deferred resume on an unmerged PR, the request eventually applies unless the PR is externally settled.

statements.name: CIRequestProgress
statements.says: An unheld follow-up needing CI eventually requests it if no unresolved effect or repair need intervenes.

statements.name: DeferredResumeFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually applies a remembered resume whenever reconciliation leaves that step enabled.

statements.name: CIRequestFairness
statements.says: The factory eventually requests CI for a revision whenever that step remains enabled.

statements.name: MergeAuthorizationAsCompletion
statements.says: The factory incorrectly treats accepting merge authorization as a completed remote merge.

statements.name: ExecuteRepairTwice
statements.says: Recovery incorrectly executes the same repair operation a second time.

statements.name: AcceptStaleRepairOutcome
statements.says: The factory incorrectly accepts a failed repair completion carrying an older operation identity.

statements.name: FabricateCIFailure
statements.says: The factory incorrectly reports an agent execution failure as a GitHub CI failure.

statements.name: NoChangeWaitsForCI
statements.says: The factory incorrectly waits for a fresh CI run after a repair produced no publishable change.

statements.name: KeepCIOnNewHead
statements.says: The factory incorrectly keeps a passing CI result after the head changes.

statements.name: OutcomeLiftsClosure
statements.says: A repair completion incorrectly releases a closure hold.

statements.name: RefusalRetriesAutomatically
statements.says: A clean definitive merge refusal incorrectly becomes ready for automatic retry.

statements.name: ResumeBeforeReconciliation
statements.says: The factory incorrectly applies a remembered resume before the earlier effect is reconciled.

statements.name: RevisionRenewsAllowance
statements.says: The factory incorrectly renews the repair allowance when observing a new revision.

statements.name: ExternalMergeInventsCI
statements.says: The factory incorrectly invents passing CI when recording an external merge.

statements.name: OldOutcomeAfterRenewalRejected
statements.says: An older operation completion can be rejected after an explicit renewal while the new operation remains active.

statements.name: RevisionKeepsClosureHold
statements.says: A new revision can invalidate CI without releasing the closure hold.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE DecisionFollowup ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, TLC

CONSTANTS Followups, SpecLines, ReadmePassages, RepairsPerRequest,
    MaxRenewals, MaxHeadMoves, Exercises

\* One plan and one stable PR. Revision numbers stand for distinct immutable heads.
\* The finite exploration permits MaxRenewals human requests and MaxHeadMoves
\* independent head changes; automatic work is never stopped by an operation cap.
\* Exercises partition representative environments to avoid multiplying independent
\* histories: repairs, a single conflict, a revision with no human renewal, and
\* merge refusal/closure. Every policy outcome has a witness; this finite draft
\* does not enumerate every cross-exercise interleaving. Other classifications
\* use a simple successful path, since their evidence and artifacts are immutable.
\* Observations denote current ordered remote facts; notification delivery and
\* durable recovery protocol composition are outside this amendment.
\* Effect results are environmental facts awaiting delivery or reconciliation.
\* Executing an effect and accepting its outcome are separate steps, including
\* when the reply is lost. No fairness assumes that GitHub or a person responds.
VARIABLES planMerged, decisionOwed, door, executed, phase, draft,
    followup, created, bundle, ci, ciFresh, conflict, repairsUsed, hold, event,
    head, ciHead, repairError, failureCause, effect, resumePending, renewals, headMoves, exercise

vars == <<planMerged, decisionOwed, door, executed, phase, draft,
    followup, created, bundle, ci, ciFresh, conflict, repairsUsed, hold, event,
    head, ciHead, repairError, failureCause, effect, resumePending, renewals, headMoves, exercise>>

NoFollowup == "none"

DecisionId == "newDecision"

Sources == {"plan", "mergedChange", "review"}

AllowedFiles == {"decisions/", "SPEC.md", "README"}

Phases == {"waiting", "drafting", "draftFailed", "readyToCreate",
    "creating", "createFailed", "open", "needsRepair", "repairing", "merging",
    "blocked", "closed", "mergeRefused", "merged", "externallyMerged"}

Holds == {"none", "exhausted", "closed", "mergeRefused"}

CIValues == {"none", "pending", "passed", "failed"}

RepairErrors == {"none", "failed", "noChange"}

Causes == {"ci", "conflict", "execution"}

EffectKinds == {"none", "repair", "merge"}

EffectStages == {"idle", "authorized", "pending", "lost", "settled"}

EffectResults == {"none", "published", "failed", "noChange", "merged", "refused"}

EffectType == [id : Nat, kind : EffectKinds, head : Nat,
    stage : EffectStages, runs : Nat, result : EffectResults, cause : SUBSET Causes]

EmptyEffect == [id |-> 0, kind |-> "none", head |-> 0,
    stage |-> "idle", runs |-> 0, result |-> "none", cause |-> {}]

Token(id, kind, revision) == [id |-> id, kind |-> kind, head |-> revision]

NoToken == Token(0, "none", 0)

RepairOutcomes == {"repairPublished", "repairSuperseded", "repairFailed", "repairNoChange"}

MergeOutcomes == {"merge", "mergeRefusal"}

OutcomeEvents == RepairOutcomes \cup MergeOutcomes

EffectEvents == OutcomeEvents \cup {"repair", "mergeAuthorize", "executeRepair",
    "executeMerge", "lostReply", "externalMerge", "rejectOutcome", "rejectCI"}

ObservationEvents == RepairOutcomes \cup {"mergeRefusal", "externalMerge",
    "revision", "rejectCI", "rejectOutcome"}

EventKinds == {"initial", "planMerge", "draftStart", "draftRetry", "draftFailure",
    "draftSuccess", "createStart", "createRetry", "createFailure", "create",
    "requestCI", "check", "conflict", "repair", "block", "close", "retry", "resume",
    "deferResume", "mergeAuthorize", "executeRepair", "executeMerge", "lostReply",
    "repairPublished", "repairSuperseded", "repairFailed", "repairNoChange",
    "merge", "mergeRefusal", "externalMerge", "revision", "rejectCI", "rejectOutcome"}

\* Transition evidence is normalized when a field is irrelevant, to keep the
\* bounded graph small; it is not an observation supplied to the workflow.
Active(e) == e.stage \in {"authorized", "pending", "lost"}

PriorEffect(kind) ==
    IF kind \in {"repair", "mergeAuthorize"} THEN
        [EmptyEffect EXCEPT !.id = effect.id,
            !.stage = IF Active(effect) THEN "authorized" ELSE "idle"]
    ELSE IF kind = "resume" THEN
        [EmptyEffect EXCEPT !.stage = IF Active(effect) THEN "authorized" ELSE "idle"]
    ELSE IF kind \in EffectEvents THEN effect ELSE EmptyEffect

EventWithToken(kind, token) ==
    [kind |-> kind, previousRepairs |-> repairsUsed, previousHold |-> hold,
     previousHead |-> IF kind \in ObservationEvents THEN head ELSE 0,
     previousCI |-> IF kind \in ObservationEvents THEN ci ELSE "none",
     previousCIHead |-> IF kind \in ObservationEvents THEN ciHead ELSE 0,
     previousFresh |-> IF kind \in ObservationEvents THEN ciFresh ELSE FALSE,
     previousConflict |-> IF kind \in ObservationEvents THEN conflict ELSE FALSE,
     previousEffect |-> PriorEffect(kind),
     previousResume |-> IF kind \in {"resume", "deferResume", "externalMerge", "merge"}
        THEN resumePending ELSE FALSE,
     token |-> token]

Event(kind) == EventWithToken(kind, NoToken)

EmptyDraft == [status |-> "none", decidedBy |-> "none",
    needsOwner |-> TRUE, sources |-> {}]

DraftValue(needsOwner) ==
    [status |-> IF door = "two-way" /\ executed /\ ~needsOwner
        THEN "decided" ELSE "proposed",
     decidedBy |-> IF door = "two-way" /\ executed /\ ~needsOwner
        THEN "agent" ELSE "none",
     needsOwner |-> needsOwner, sources |-> Sources]

EmptyBundle ==
    [command |-> "none", journal |-> "none", logRow |-> "none",
     specCitations |-> [s \in SpecLines |-> "none"],
     readmeCitations |-> [r \in ReadmePassages |-> "none"],
     rolledUp |-> FALSE, files |-> {}]

CompleteBundleValue ==
    [command |-> "invariant decisions decide", journal |-> DecisionId, logRow |-> DecisionId,
     specCitations |-> [s \in SpecLines |-> DecisionId],
     readmeCitations |-> [r \in ReadmePassages |-> DecisionId],
     rolledUp |-> TRUE, files |-> AllowedFiles]

Terminal == phase \in {"merged", "externallyMerged"}

Live == followup # NoFollowup /\ ~Terminal

RemoteUnmerged == effect.result # "merged"

NeedsRepair == ci = "failed" \/ conflict \/ repairError # "none"

CurrentCauses == (IF ci = "failed" THEN {"ci"} ELSE {})
    \cup (IF conflict THEN {"conflict"} ELSE {})
    \cup (IF repairError # "none" THEN {"execution"} ELSE {})

PhaseFor(h, e, check, collision, err) ==
    IF h = "closed" THEN "closed"
    ELSE IF h = "exhausted" THEN "blocked"
    ELSE IF h = "mergeRefused" THEN "mergeRefused"
    ELSE IF Active(e) THEN IF e.kind = "repair" THEN "repairing" ELSE "merging"
    ELSE IF check = "failed" \/ collision \/ err # "none" THEN "needsRepair"
    ELSE "open"

ReadyToMerge == phase = "open" /\ ci = "passed" /\ ciFresh /\ ~conflict
    /\ ciHead = head /\ hold = "none" /\ ~Active(effect) /\ repairError = "none"

NewEffect(kind) == [id |-> effect.id + 1, kind |-> kind, head |-> head,
    stage |-> "authorized", runs |-> 0, result |-> "none",
    cause |-> IF kind = "repair" THEN CurrentCauses ELSE {}]

MatchingOutcome(id, kind, revision) ==
    /\ Active(effect) /\ effect.stage \in {"pending", "lost"}
    /\ id = effect.id /\ kind = effect.kind /\ revision = effect.head

SameObservation ==
    /\ head = event.previousHead
    /\ ci = event.previousCI /\ ciHead = event.previousCIHead
    /\ ciFresh = event.previousFresh /\ conflict = event.previousConflict

TypeOK ==
    /\ planMerged \in BOOLEAN
    /\ decisionOwed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ door \in {"one-way", "two-way"}
    /\ executed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ draft \in [status : {"none", "proposed", "decided"},
        decidedBy : {"none", "agent"}, needsOwner : BOOLEAN, sources : SUBSET Sources]
    /\ followup \in Followups \cup {NoFollowup}
    /\ created \subseteq Followups
    /\ bundle \in [command : {"none", "invariant decisions decide"},
        journal : {"none", DecisionId}, logRow : {"none", DecisionId},
        specCitations : [SpecLines -> {"none", DecisionId}],
        readmeCitations : [ReadmePassages -> {"none", DecisionId}],
        rolledUp : BOOLEAN, files : SUBSET (AllowedFiles \cup {"code"})]
    /\ ci \in CIValues /\ ciFresh \in BOOLEAN /\ conflict \in BOOLEAN
    /\ repairsUsed \in Nat /\ hold \in Holds
    /\ head \in Nat /\ ciHead \in Nat
    /\ repairError \in RepairErrors /\ failureCause \subseteq Causes
    /\ effect \in EffectType /\ resumePending \in BOOLEAN
    /\ renewals \in 0..MaxRenewals /\ headMoves \in 0..MaxHeadMoves
    /\ exercise \in Exercises \cup {"simple"}
    /\ event \in [kind : EventKinds, previousRepairs : Nat, previousHold : Holds,
        previousHead : Nat, previousCI : CIValues, previousCIHead : Nat,
        previousFresh : BOOLEAN, previousConflict : BOOLEAN,
        previousEffect : EffectType, previousResume : BOOLEAN,
        token : [id : Nat, kind : EffectKinds, head : Nat]]

MergeRequiresCurrentCI == phase = "merged" => ci = "passed" /\ ciFresh

OneFollowup == Cardinality(created) <= 1

RepairAllowance == repairsUsed <= RepairsPerRequest

HumanHoldRespected ==
    /\ (hold = "closed" <=> phase = "closed")
    /\ (hold = "exhausted" <=> phase = "blocked")
    /\ (hold = "mergeRefused" <=> phase = "mergeRefused")
    /\ (event.previousHold # "none"
        /\ event.kind \notin {"retry", "resume", "merge", "externalMerge"}
        => hold = IF event.kind = "close" THEN "closed" ELSE event.previousHold)

OnlyOwedMergedPlans == phase # "waiting" => planMerged /\ decisionOwed

StableFollowupIdentity ==
    /\ (followup = NoFollowup <=> created = {})
    /\ (followup # NoFollowup => created = {followup})
    /\ (phase \in {"open", "needsRepair", "repairing", "merging", "blocked",
        "closed", "mergeRefused", "merged", "externallyMerged"}
        <=> followup # NoFollowup)

DraftUsesEvidence == draft.status # "none" => draft.sources = Sources

DecisionClassification ==
    draft.status # "none" =>
        /\ (draft.status = "decided" <=>
            door = "two-way" /\ executed /\ ~draft.needsOwner)
        /\ (draft.decidedBy = "agent" <=> draft.status = "decided")

FollowupHasDecision == followup # NoFollowup => draft.status \in {"decided", "proposed"}

DecisionCommandUsed == followup # NoFollowup => bundle.command = "invariant decisions decide"

JournalAndLogAgree == followup # NoFollowup =>
    bundle.journal = DecisionId /\ bundle.logRow = DecisionId

CitationsCoverChangedText == followup # NoFollowup =>
    /\ \A s \in SpecLines : bundle.specCitations[s] = DecisionId
    /\ \A r \in ReadmePassages : bundle.readmeCitations[r] = DecisionId

SpecIsRolledUp == followup # NoFollowup => bundle.rolledUp

FollowupScope == bundle.files \subseteq AllowedFiles

MergeWithoutConflict == phase = "merged" => ~conflict

CurrentCIResults == ci \in {"passed", "failed"} => ciFresh /\ ciHead = head

EachRepairStartsFreshCI == event.kind = "repairPublished" =>
    /\ head = event.previousHead + 1 /\ ci = "none" /\ ~ciFresh /\ ciHead = 0
    /\ repairsUsed = event.previousRepairs

RequestsRenewAllowance == event.kind \in {"retry", "resume"} => repairsUsed = 0

AllowanceAccounting ==
    IF event.kind = "repair" THEN repairsUsed = event.previousRepairs + 1
    ELSE IF event.kind \in {"retry", "resume"} THEN repairsUsed = 0
    ELSE repairsUsed = event.previousRepairs

ExhaustionIsBlocked == phase = "blocked" => repairsUsed = RepairsPerRequest

RepairAuthorizationCharged == event.kind = "repair" =>
    /\ repairsUsed = event.previousRepairs + 1
    /\ effect.kind = "repair" /\ effect.stage = "authorized"
    /\ effect.runs = 0 /\ effect.result = "none" /\ effect.cause # {}

RepairFailureIsSeparate == event.kind \in {"repairFailed", "repairNoChange"} =>
    /\ SameObservation
    /\ repairError = IF event.kind = "repairFailed" THEN "failed" ELSE "noChange"
    /\ failureCause = event.previousEffect.cause /\ failureCause # {}
    /\ effect.stage = "settled"

RepairFailureRemainsActionable ==
    repairError # "none" /\ Live /\ hold = "none" /\ ~Active(effect)
        => phase = "needsRepair"

RevisionInvalidatesCI == event.kind = "revision" =>
    /\ head = event.previousHead + 1 /\ ci = "none" /\ ciHead = 0 /\ ~ciFresh
    /\ repairsUsed = event.previousRepairs /\ hold = event.previousHold

TruthfulFollowupState == Live =>
    phase = PhaseFor(hold, effect, ci, conflict, repairError)

StableOperationIdentity ==
    /\ (Active(effect) => followup # NoFollowup /\ effect.id > 0 /\ effect.head > 0)
    /\ (event.kind \in {"repair", "mergeAuthorize"} =>
        /\ ~Active(event.previousEffect)
        /\ effect.id = event.previousEffect.id + 1 /\ effect.head = head)
    /\ (event.kind \in EffectEvents \ {"repair", "mergeAuthorize"} =>
        /\ effect.id = event.previousEffect.id
        /\ effect.kind = event.previousEffect.kind /\ effect.head = event.previousEffect.head)

EffectRunsOnce ==
    /\ effect.runs <= 1
    /\ (effect.stage = "authorized" => effect.runs = 0 /\ effect.result = "none")
    /\ (effect.stage \in {"pending", "lost"} => effect.runs = 1 /\ effect.result # "none")
    /\ (event.kind \in {"executeRepair", "executeMerge"} =>
        /\ event.previousEffect.stage = "authorized" /\ event.previousEffect.runs = 0
        /\ effect.runs = 1)
    /\ (event.kind = "lostReply" =>
        /\ effect.stage = "lost" /\ effect.runs = event.previousEffect.runs
        /\ effect.result = event.previousEffect.result)

OutcomeGuards == event.kind \in OutcomeEvents =>
    /\ event.previousEffect.stage \in {"pending", "lost"}
    /\ event.token = Token(event.previousEffect.id,
        event.previousEffect.kind, event.previousEffect.head)
    /\ effect.stage = "settled" /\ effect.runs = event.previousEffect.runs
    /\ effect.result = event.previousEffect.result
    /\ (event.kind \in RepairOutcomes => event.previousEffect.kind = "repair")
    /\ (event.kind \in MergeOutcomes => event.previousEffect.kind = "merge")
    /\ (event.kind = "repairPublished" => effect.result = "published"

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The workflow starts in Init and advances only through Next steps.

pins.name: MergeRequiresCurrentCI
pins.says: The factory merges a follow-up only with passing CI for its current contents.

pins.name: OneFollowup
pins.says: A plan's decision obligation produces at most one follow-up pull request.

pins.name: RepairAllowance
pins.says: The factory uses at most two automatic repairs in each allowance.

pins.name: HumanHoldRespected
pins.says: Closure, exhausted repairs and definitive merge refusal hold the same follow-up for a person, and observations and in-flight outcomes preserve that hold until an authorized retry or resume is applied or the PR is confirmed merged.

pins.name: CurrentCIResults
pins.says: A completed CI result always describes the follow-up's current contents.

pins.name: AllowanceAccounting
pins.says: Only a repair consumes the repair allowance, and only an explicit retry or resume resets it.

pins.name: DeferredResumeSafety
pins.says: Resumption requested during an unresolved effect is remembered without releasing closure or renewing repairs and is applied only after that effect is reconciled as unmerged.

pins.name: OutcomeGuards
pins.says: Only an unresolved executed operation with the matching identity, kind, authorized revision and actual result can accept a completion, and an overtaken publication cannot overwrite the observed head.

pins.name: RepairFailureIsSeparate
pins.says: A failed or unchanged repair settles its attempt, records its execution outcome and cause separately, and preserves the observed head, CI and conflict instead of inventing a CI result or run.

pins.name: EffectRunsOnce
pins.says: An authorized effect executes at most once, and a lost reply retains the same operation and outcome for reconciliation.

pins.name: MergeAuthorizationIsPending
pins.says: Merge authorization requires current passing CI and no conflict or hold and remains nonterminal until the remote outcome is confirmed.

pins.name: MergeRefusalIsTruthful
pins.says: A definitive merge refusal preserves observed facts and closure, and an otherwise ready unchanged PR waits in a merge-refused hold for an explicit retry.

pins.name: ExternalSettlementHonest
pins.says: An externally merged PR is settled as external without inventing CI, changing repair usage or applying a deferred resumption.

pins.name: TypeOK

pins.name: OnlyOwedMergedPlans

pins.name: StableFollowupIdentity
